title: A.R.M.O.R. answer to one spoken turn, the JSON of the voice reply
description: What the voice gateway answers to a spoken turn: what it heard and what it replies. In the older raw request, and in a binary request with `reply_audio` `base64`, the spoken answer is the optional `audio` field (base64 of 16 kHz 16-bit mono PCM). In a binary request with `reply_audio` `binary` it is the `audio` part of a `multipart/mixed` answer and this JSON is its `result` part, without the `audio` field. `audio_omitted` is set, with the reason, when the server left the spoken answer out: `too_large` (it was above the limit of the server).
